MAC RELEASE

Mac 1.5.21 · Refined settings and Mac utilities

Refined settings, optional keep-awake and mouse-wheel reversal.

Latest public release2026-11-16
Mac DMGMac ZIP

macOS 13 or later · Universal for Apple Silicon and Intel

HighlightsImprovementsSupport and limitsDownloads

Highlights

Settings use a gray sidebar, white content area, compact page titles and blue icons. Updates now live in General, and attendance history lives in Work. Eight themes, including Default, six color presets and Custom, appear in two columns and change colors while preserving the layout. Choose from five owl expressions or import an icon.

Install and enable the optional Keep awake and Reverse scrolling modules in Settings → Plugins. Open each installed plugin in the sidebar to configure it.

Improvements

  • The menu-bar panel has separate Settings and Quit buttons. Arrival-time edits save first; invalid input remains visible.
  • Keep awake prevents automatic display sleep while enabled and releases its assertion when disabled or when the app quits. Manual sleep, lock and lid closing are unchanged.
  • Reverse scrolling requires Accessibility permission and affects ordinary mouse-wheel events only. Trackpad and momentum events are preserved; some smooth-scrolling mice are excluded.
  • AI usage retains the Codex weekly allowance, hourly consumption rate, display, refresh and notification features from public release 1.5.20. Development Antigravity, account-management and token-speed features are excluded. Existing connection data is preserved, and ambiguous connections wait for explicit executable selection.
  • Automatic-update switches are hidden while saved preferences and behavior remain intact. Configure AI usage within its plugin.

Scope and validation

Requires macOS 13 or later, with an Apple Silicon and Intel Universal app. Windows remains at 1.5.13. The existing app identity, record paths, fixed self-signed certificate and Sparkle signing are retained. Apple Developer ID signing and notarization are not applied.

User Dev feedback confirmed the basic behavior of both new plugins. Installation and relaunch of this production package, calendar permissions/connections, prolonged keep-awake use, permission revocation, external Macs and physical Intel hardware remain separately unverified.

Downloads

Quit the existing app and replace it in the same location using the DMG or ZIP. Do not delete attendance or connection files.
